resources.string: Enter your PIN using at least 3 whole digits, 0 to 9 only. No decimal point, operators, or functions. Then press and hold =. You will enter the whole PIN again afterwards to confirm it.
Enter your operator sequence using only + − × ÷ ^, at least 3 of them. Repeats are allowed, for example × × ÷ ÷. Then press and hold =.
That isn\'t a valid PIN. Use whole digits, 0 to 9 only. No decimal point, operators, or functions. Then press and hold =.
Your PIN needs at least 3 digits. Enter 3 or more whole digits, 0 to 9, then press and hold =.
Only operators (+ − × ÷ ^) belong in the sequence. Press and hold = when the sequence is complete.
Your operator sequence needs at least 3 operators. Add more of + − × ÷ ^, then press and hold =.
That didn\'t match your first entry. Start again from the beginning, and enter the same digits and the same operator sequence both times.
Couldn\'t save the PIN on this device. Enter your PIN and press and hold = to try again.
No operators entered. Add at least one of + − × ÷ ^ after the digits, then press and hold =.
